Mo.reason: Mo appears as a token in example text (e.g., 'mO') and is not a language reference.

Korean.reason: Korean refers to the Korean language, which is part of the UGTPhon benchmark, manually annotated, and evaluated in experiments.

Vietnamese.reason: Vietnamese refers to the Vietnamese language, included in the benchmark, annotated, and evaluated.

English.reason: English refers to the English language, part of the benchmark and evaluated.
